- [RARC.13.13] **Parallelism is the integrator's, not the engine's.** Sibling
  engines may run in parallel; within an engine, processing is serial
  ([RARC.8.5.1]).
gap_reason: Parallelism is the integrator's, and an engine is serial. Both runtimes are serial, so there is no parallel run for a vector to compare.
